Alperen Şengün records a historic triple-double with 23 points, 11 rebounds and 11 assists as the Houston Rockets defeat the Phoenix Suns 116-104! Sengun also passes Hakeem Olajuwon for the second-most triple-doubles in Rockets franchise history with his 15th career triple-double.
